```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(BSgenome)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)

source(here::here("scripts", "GuideRefine-functions.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R"))
```

# Import alignment data of each sgRNA libraries and library

```{r}
# import sgRNA library
# WE SHOULD DISPOSE ANY CONTROL FROM THE SGRNA LIBRARY AS THEY ARE NOT USED IN THIS ANALYSIS

terms <- c("CONTROL", "Control", "control", "INTRON", "Intron", "intron", "LacZ", "luciferase", "NO_SITE", "ONE_INTERGENIC_SITE")
# lacZ and luciferase are the control in Toronto V3 library
terms_for_filtering <- paste(terms, collapse = "|")

avana_library_meyers <- import_sgrna_library(here::here("data", "library_data", "original_library", "avana_library.tsv"), terms_for_filtering)
brunello_library <- import_sgrna_library(here::here("data", "library_data", "original_library", "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents.tsv"), terms_for_filtering)
toronto_library <- import_sgrna_library(here::here("data", "library_data", "original_library", "tkov3_guide_sequence.tsv"), terms_for_filtering)
yusa_library <- import_sgrna_library(here::here("data", "library_data", "original_library", "yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas.tsv"), terms_for_filtering)
jacquere_library <- import_sgrna_library(here::here("data", "library_data", "original_library", "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4.tsv"), terms_for_filtering)

```

# For T2T-CHM13 use this chunk code

```{r}

annotation <- here::here("data", "annotation", "T2T-CHM13v2.0_gene_annot_granges.rds")
genome_type_version <- "T2T-CHM13"
bsgenome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0

# T2T-CHM13
avana_alignment_meyers <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "avana_data", "avana_library_aln.csv"), genome_type_version)
brunello_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "brunello_data", "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents_aln.csv"), genome_type_version)
toronto_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "tkov3_data", "tkov3_guide_sequence_aln.csv"), genome_type_version)
yusa_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "yusa_data", "yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas_aln.csv"), genome_type_version)
jacquere_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "jacquere_data", "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4_aln.csv"), genome_type_version)

# list_removed_sgrna sgRNAs
disposed_avana <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13", "avana_library_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_brunello <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13", "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_toronto <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13", "tkov3_guide_sequence_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_yusa <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13", "yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_jacquere <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13", "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))

```

# Classify the sgRNAs in each libraries

```{r}

# off_target_classification() has three arguments, the second one is looking for PAM-distal single mismatch, you can turn this off by put it as NA. Therefore the PAM-distal single mismatch will be considered as single mismatch sgRNA

avana_classification <- off_target_classification(avana_alignment_meyers, 
                                                  NA, 
                                                  disposed_avana["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])
write_csv(avana_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "avana_data", "avana_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

brunello_classification <- off_target_classification(brunello_alignment,
                                                     NA,
                                                     disposed_brunello["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])
write_csv(brunello_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "brunello_data", "brunello_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

toronto_classification <- off_target_classification(toronto_alignment,
                                                    NA,
                                                    disposed_toronto["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])

write_csv(toronto_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "tkov3_data", "tkov3_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

yusa_classification <- off_target_classification(yusa_alignment,
                                                 NA,
                                                 disposed_yusa["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])

write_csv(yusa_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "yusa_data", "yusa_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

jacquere_classification <- off_target_classification(jacquere_alignment,
                                                     NA,
                                                     disposed_jacquere["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])

write_csv(jacquere_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "jacquere_data", "jacquere_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

```
